verses.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.pt: O meu coração trasborda de boas palavras; dirijo os meus versos ao rei; a minha língua é qual pena de um hábil escriba.
verses.en_web: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.> My heart is flowing over with good things; my words are of that which I have made for a king; my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.pt: Tu és o mais formoso dos filhos dos homens; a graça se derramou nos teus lábios; por isso Deus te abençoou para sempre.
verses.en_web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.en_bbe: You are fairer than the children of men; grace is flowing through your lips; for this cause the blessing of God is with you for ever.

verses.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.pt: Cinge a tua espada à coxa, ó valente, na tua glória e majestade.
verses.en_web: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
verses.en_bbe: Put on your sword, make it ready at your side, O strong chief, with your glory and power.

verses.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.pt: E em tua majestade cavalga vitoriosamente pela causa da verdade, da mansidão e da justiça, e a tua destra te ensina coisas terríveis.
verses.en_web: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
verses.en_bbe: And go nobly on in your power, because you are good and true and without pride; and your right hand will be teaching you things of fear.

verses.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.pt: As tuas flechas são agudas no coração dos inimigos do rei; os povos caem debaixo de ti.
verses.en_web: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.en_bbe: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's haters; because of them the peoples are falling under you.

verses.en: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.pt: O teu trono, ó Deus, subsiste pelos séculos dos séculos; cetro de eqüidade é o cetro do teu reino.
verses.en_web: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; the rod of your kingdom is a rod of honour.

verses.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.pt: Amaste a justiça e odiaste a iniqüidade; por isso Deus, o teu Deus, te ungiu com óleo de alegria, mais do que a teus companheiros.
verses.en_web: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.en_bbe: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil: and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head, lifting you high over all other kings.

verses.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.pt: Todas as tuas vestes cheiram a mirra a aloés e a cássia; dos palácios de marfim os instrumentos de cordas e te alegram.
verses.en_web: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
verses.en_bbe: Your robes are full of the smell of all sorts of perfumes and spices; music from the king's ivory houses has made you glad.

verses.en: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.pt: Filhas de reis estão entre as tuas ilustres donzelas; à tua mão direita está a rainha, ornada de ouro de Ofir.
verses.en_web: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
verses.en_bbe: Kings' daughters are among your noble women: on your right is the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;
verses.pt: Ouve, filha, e olha, e inclina teus ouvidos; esquece-te do teu povo e da casa de teu pai.
verses.en_web: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: O daughter, give thought and attention, and let your ear be open; no longer keep in mind your people, and your father's house;

verses.en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.pt: Então o rei se afeiçoará à tua formosura. Ele é teu senhor, presta-lhe, pois, homenagem.
verses.en_web: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.en_bbe: So will the king have a great desire for you, seeing how beautiful you are; because he is your lord, give him honour.

verses.en: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.pt: A filha de Tiro estará ali com presentes; os ricos do povo suplicarão o teu favor.
verses.en_web: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
verses.en_bbe: And the daughters of Tyre will be there with an offering; those who have wealth among the people will be looking for your approval.

verses.en: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.pt: A filha do rei está esplendente lá dentro do palácio; as suas vestes são entretecidas de ouro.
verses.en_web: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.en_bbe: In the great house the king's daughter is all shining: her clothing is worked with gold.

verses.en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.pt: Em vestidos de cores brilhantes será conduzida ao rei; as virgens, suas companheiras que a seguem, serão trazidas à tua presença.
verses.en_web: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
verses.en_bbe: She will come before the king in robes of needlework; the virgins in her train will come before you.

verses.en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.pt: Com alegria e regozijo serão trazidas; elas entrarão no palácio do rei.
verses.en_web: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.en_bbe: With joy and rapture will they come; they will go into the king's house.

verses.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.pt: Em lugar de teus pais estarão teus filhos; tu os farás príncipes sobre toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Your children will take the place of your fathers; so that you may make them rulers over all the earth.

verses.en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Farei lembrado o teu nome de geração em geração; pelo que os povos te louvarão eternamente.
verses.en_web: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep the memory of your name living through all generations; and because of this the people will give you praise for ever.
